content: Fadǝghǝr tǝ Kristi ma adzahadzaha Muusa
Ma sarta kwa ba zarh nǝ dadda gwiiga, ba kalkal nǝ iin da ɛva, aanzdu ba dǝgan nǝ dǝgit hǝnyah baɗǝma.
Dadda gwiigǝn ba miizhadǝva lii hǝkyǝgana tangw damma sarti fa nǝ daddaana.
Bandkwah nǝ miyama lakwti sagau nǝ ɗuula Kristiya. Ndza kiyam band ɛvah vak ndzǝɗa tlǝksǝra duniya.
Ɓagaa ba nǝ righǝga sarta kwa fa nǝ Daadamazhigǝla, kaa ɓǝldiɓǝlǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Zǝraana, sahi tǝdvad uusa. Favɗǝm mazhagyil kǝ adzahadzaha Muus bamma sarta yiigaana,
mbakyarvad vartǝrdan kǝ lii miizhagyil kǝ adzahadzaha Muusa, natǝrdalnǝg kǝ zarha Daadamazhigǝla.
Aɗaba am zarhaana, ɓǝladiɓǝlǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝl kǝ shǝdkwa zǝran damma ǝrviɗmahuɗaruwa, Daadamazhigǝl taakiya, “Abba! Daada!”
Agha madla bi nǝng ɛv biya, agha zǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Nǝghalnǝg tsau kǝ zǝra, nakadalnǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝl kǝ dadda gwiiga.
Ta ngyahwa Bulus tǝ Galatiyaha
Ndzam sǝrgai kǝ Daadamazhigǝl wurwur biya, ndzam ɓagar kwatǝnahǝr kǝ ghǝllaha kwa ɓagaa nǝ uuda.

Aɗaba ndakwana am sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, dlaɓa sǝrkwursǝrǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝla, am gwiya da mǝr dlaɓ miizhagyil kǝ kwarǝg ndzǝɗa duni kwa maay nǝ tlǝran biyi? Aujilɓǝg dlaɓ am gwiya na nǝg kǝ ɛvaha tǝri?
Am vǝldavǝlǝg kǝ ghǝraru kǝ tsuufa kyalma hǝngaha ard kyilaha, ard sartaha, ard viigaha.
Ən gǝdzǝkurgǝdzǝga, aɗaba mandki baɗǝm nǝ dlaɗi ǝn huɓǝg nai tǝghǝr kǝskuuramna nalnaǝg ba gyaagyaana!
Ən ghalakuuram zaraabahara, namalnǝg band kaiya. Aɗaba kai ndakwani mana nal band kuurama. Ɓagamwi bi nǝ uuram kǝ haip biya.
Am sǝrgasǝrǝg taakiya yang biyin ɓagana naina, iin wa wurghwant ɗuua lankur ǝlbǝg maraw ba zunngwa.

Aanji ba sakurdaasǝg kǝ damuuw nǝ yangbiyin ɓaga na naina, bakǝvakwaha nenǝmkwi biya dlaɓa lamwabi kǝ fa hyǝmi tǝ kai biya. Caawamkwicaug band zǝrɓǝlgah ma ghǝrazhigǝla, band kwa caawama nǝ uuram kǝ Kristi Yesu dǝ ghǝraana.
Ndzam dlaiga ba vaivaiy ma sartiina! Ən hwaɗag nai ndkwana mbakyarvad cinngamwanacinga? Ən sǝrgasǝrǝg nai ma sartakwahiina aanji ba zǝra gyiyaharu ndkwani ma taɗamdataɗǝg am vǝlwana!
Mbats nanalnǝg nai kǝ tlǝghumaru ndakwan kwakyarvad tagankurtag kǝ jiira?
Kwanahan kǝ uudaha ar kǝma ndzǝgan dǝ kuurama, dǝgiti ar tlatlǝg nǝ iitǝra ba ghawɗa. Ar naa tagkwiyamtagwa ǝmtaɗa, mbakyarvad ar viyǝt kǝ hǝnkalaru baɓǝm da vakatǝra.
Maraw nǝ kǝma hulfa ndzǝgan ǝndkwana. Aa ɓagarɓag ba kǝlahǝng bandkwana, ba mar nǝgha kai vakaru nǝ iitǝr biya.
Kuuram zaraabahara, nalnǝg kǝ dǝga bu wan kǝskai ǝn cinnga dlaɗa yiig kǝ urama. Dlaɓa ǝn za ba vuuk dǝ kwanǝn kǝ dlaɗa bamma ndzandzǝg nǝ hǝnkala Kristi ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaruwa.
Akwamana ba ǝmtaɗ dǝ kuurama ndakwana, mana mbǝɗanǝn kǝ kunghyara. Aɗaba ǝn dzama ghǝr ba vaivai mbakyarvad kuurama.
Garav tǝghǝr kǝ Hagar ard Saratu
Tagamwataga, kuuramǝn am gata ba adzahadzaha Muusa, nǝghamakanǝghǝg dǝ dǝgiti tsag na adzahadzaha?
Aɗaba vinndavinndan taakiya Ibrahim ndza dǝ zarh buwa ghwalvaha, palla yava tǝdvad uusa kwa ɛva, pall dlaɓa tǝdvad uusa kwa kwara ghǝraana.
Zǝran kwa yava dǝ uusa ɛva, tlakǝna band kwa tlǝfkǝna nǝ zarha. Kiyava zǝran kwa yava dǝ uusa kwa kwara ghǝraana yava tǝdvad langyi kwa tǝghara nǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Kwan kǝ garava ǝmghwasahaana, iin nǝ langyi buwa. Hagar iin wa yaa ɛva.
Hagar wa nalnǝg kǝ garava Aghwa Sinai kwa ma haaya Arabiya. Iin nǝ garava kǝsa Wurshalima ndakwana, aɗaba iina ard zarhaana ar ba ɛvah baɗǝma.
Aɗaba Wurshalima kwa ma ghǝazhigǝla dǝ kwara ghǝra, dlaɓa iin baabamiyama.

Vinndavidan taakiya, “Ɓag kǝ hwaɗaga kǝgh uusa kwa yigha bi kǝ zǝr biya, Agha tlǝhga hwaɗaga mbakyarvad tapghanabi kǝ dlada yaa zǝr biya, aɗaba zarha uusa kwa ɗuughars nǝ zhiilana ɓagaraɓag ba dyeka. Jaruujig kǝ zarha uusii dǝ zhiilaana.”
Aiciya, zaraabahara, niyamalnǝg ghǝravamiyam kǝ zarha Daadamazhigǝl tǝdvad langyiya band Ishaku.
Ma sartakwahiina zǝrǝn yava band kwa yahav nǝ zarha vǝlgharvǝlǝg kǝ dlaɗ kǝ zǝrǝn kwa yava tǝdvad ndzǝɗa Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla. Bandkwah dlaɓ tangw dat hiinana.
Vinnɗavinnɗan ma kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl taakiya, “Lagwdalagw kǝ uusǝn ɛvana ard zǝraana, aɗaba zǝrǝn yava dǝ ɛvana da maay tagwa dǝga gwiig ǝmtaɗ dǝ zǝra uusǝn kwa kwara ghǝrǝn biya.”
Mbakyarvad kwaha zaraabahara, kiyam zarha uusiin kwa ɛva biya, kiyam zarha uusǝn kwa dǝ kwarǝga ghǝra.
